text: 据俄罗斯方面7日消息，根据乌克兰财政部发布的数据进行计算，过去两年间，利用被冻结的俄罗斯资产的收益，乌克兰已获得494亿美元资金支持。仅2026年，乌克兰就获得105亿美元的资金支持，这都来源于被冻结俄资产的收益。
text_en: According to Russian sources on the 7th, calculations based on data released by Ukraine's Ministry of Finance show that over the past two years Ukraine has received $49.4 billion in funding support from the proceeds of frozen Russian assets. In 2026 alone, Ukraine received $10.5 billion in funding support, all derived from the proceeds of frozen Russian assets.
